scope: Original research verifier on fixed synthetic files; not AP-013, signed provenance, live gallery integration or production validation

results.finding: Typed image/export IDs can share text without aliasing; successful identity check retains DECLARED/PARTIAL.
Same file name and ID with changed bytes fails the original digest.
A missing source artifact prevents a verified packet association.
Duplicate typed IDs/versions are rejected rather than selecting the last record.
A gallery reference to another version is rejected.
A source-to-output link cannot point to an absent typed asset.
Image and source-export namespaces are not interchangeable.
A changed manifest fails the separately retained packet anchor.
Renaming a file with unchanged bytes and explicit identity does not break this identity check.
Replacing payload, metadata AND accepted anchor yields a match: hashes alone do not authenticate origin.
